summary:
Reviewed w140: one commit, 2a2c0de. It is a rebase of the 862a5f8 the implementer's result lists, with the same change.
work answer on an awaiting-answer capability-proposal writes the dated answer, keeps the status, writes no log line and commits only the proposal's file. This meets r24 and r9. The work-item path is unchanged.
No change under features/. No test removed or weakened. No allowances claimed.
tools check is clean and tools size prints nothing. The focused answer/commit scenarios give 10 passed.
Two Minor findings: the proposal is detected by a substring instead of the frontmatter parser (observation), and the docstrings are stale (drop).
